items.title: In his stillness, Litton finds time
items.summary: At the Wanderers Stadium, the importance of the runs, coupled with the consummate ease with which he scored them, put pressure back on one of the best bowling units in the world.

items.title: Sylhet crowned Women's NCL champions
items.summary: Sylhet Division were crowned champions of the 15th Women's National Cricket League after beating Rajshahi Division by five wickets in their seventh and final-round match at the Cox's Bazar Academy Ground on Monday.

items.title: 'Whenever Bangladesh are in trouble, I want to handle it': Litton
items.summary: Bangladesh wicketkeeper-batter Litton Das has developed a habit of firing when his team is in dire straits. Following his famous rescue acts in Rawalpindi in 2024 and Sylhet last year against Pakistan, Litton produced another immaculate century on Day 2 of the first Test against South Africa at the Wanderers Stadium on Monday.

items.title: Litton: 'I always see crisis situations as opportunities'
items.summary: Walking in at 121 for 5, the batter made his eighth Test hundred and dedicated it to his daughter

items.title: Abu Jayed's maiden 10-for puts Sylhet in the mix for NCL title
items.summary: Pacer Abu Jayed completed a second five-wicket haul in the match to claim his maiden 10-wicket haul in first-class cricket and help Sylhet Division secure an innings-and-38-run victory over Barishal Division inside three days in their final-round National Cricket League match in Khulna on Monday.

items.title: Wanderers Test: Will Bangladesh follow history or South Africa rewrite it?
items.summary: At the end of the second day of the first Test today, the tourists had every reason to feel proud of their batting achievement, but South Africa's strong response had made the contest far more intriguing.

items.title: Tigresses leave Super Six fate hanging after defeat against Netherlands
items.summary: Bangladesh suffered their second defeat in the ongoing ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026, going down by five wickets to the Netherlands in their third Group B match in Ajman on Monday.

items.title: Hridoy points to self-belief and process as keys to Wanderers success
items.summary: With a magnificent 137 at the Wanderers in Johannesburg, the Bangladesh batter once again demonstrated his ability to adjust to challenging conditions without losing sight of his strengths. For Hridoy, the key lies in trusting his ability and sticking to his process.

items.title: ‘Happy birthday my princess, this 100 for you’
items.summary: The Bangladesh wicketkeeper-batter pulled out a piece of paper bearing a heartfelt message: “Happy Birthday my Princess, This 100 for you.” The gesture drew applause from the Bangladesh dugout as Litton celebrated his first Test century on South African soil.

items.title: Hasan drags Tigers back into the contest after Ackerman's onslaught
items.summary: Bangladesh wicketkeeper Litton Das put down a late chance on Day 2, denying pacer Hasan Mahmud a fourth wicket as the Tigers clawed their way back into the contest after a gruelling day in the field in the first Test against South Africa at the Wanderers Stadium on Monday.

items.title: Rabada goes from 'not short and wide' to five in no time
items.summary: He took the first five Bangladesh wickets to fall in Johannesburg but South Africa let the advantage slip

items.title: Bangladesh, USA to host men's and women's LA28 qualifying tournaments

items.title: Hridoy and Litton's 206-run stand powers Bangladesh after Rabada's five-for

items.title: Bangladesh opt to bat first in series opener at the Wanderers
items.summary: Twenty-two-year-old Mahfijul Islam makes his debut for Bangladesh, while South Africa picked Zubayr Hamza at No. 3 and Dane Paterson as the fourth seamer

items.title: Shanto: 'Very important for the whole batting unit to perform'
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain said their bowling attack can "compete" if the batters post a big total in the first innings

items.title: On-song South Africa host Bangladesh with an eye on another WTC final
items.summary: Hamza and Paterson return to South Africa's XI in what is Johannesburg's first Test since March 2023

items.summary: Series against Bangladesh begins on Sunday, and Rabada hopes "some exciting cricket" shows "how healthy cricket is" in SA

items.title: Rizwanullah, openers set up big win as Pakistan make U-19 Asia Cup final
items.summary: Rizwanullah's five-for restricted Bangladesh to 138 following which Usman Khan and Hayam Khan mowed down the target with ease
